hints.input: Indentation is semantic in YAML, so minify only drops blank lines and document separators; it never changes the indentation itself.
hints.action: Validate only reports whether the syntax is legal; it does not rewrite the content.
hints.indent: The indent width is measured in spaces; 2, 4 and 8 are available.
hints.sortKeys: Sorting only affects the key order of mappings; comments and anchors are still preserved.
hints.output: Format keeps comments and key order; minify removes redundant blank lines and `---` separators.

faq.a: No. The tool re-lays out the node tree, so comments and anchors survive.

faq.q: Why can valid YAML still be rejected?
faq.a: YAML is indentation sensitive, so one extra space can change the structure. The tool reports the offending line number to make it easy to find.
Aliases can expand a document exponentially, so the tool counts aliases and nesting depth before expanding and rejects anything above the limit.
